objective: Validate finite Profile-required review perspectives with actual DSH official Team authorship, context and durable output bound to exact artifacts and acyclic inputs.
recommended_considerations: Derive perspectives and propositions from the Profile, never a fixed role or model matrix.
Use official Team members, task CAS and messages; record fresh/fork context and observed limitations.
Record original opinions and evidence, cross-check disagreements through Team messages, and preserve unresolved findings; bounded rework does not require consensus.
Observe the local host trust boundary: messages accepted and Team tasks complete are not review validity; same-permission tampering is outside the assurance.

Carry unresolved source-bound findings across related target revisions. Link each disposition to the exact original review digest and finding ID; keep historical disposition distinct from current-input authorization.
